description: Perform a zero-downtime blue-green deployment for a critical payments API service. Spin up a full green stack including Deployments, Services, and Ingress resources in parallel with the existing blue stack. Run smoke tests and comprehensive health checks against the green service endpoint. Once green passes all checks, switch the production Ingress or DNS record to point to the green service. Monitor for 30 minutes, then drain and decommission the blue stack. The old blue stack must remain fully operational for instantaneous rollback if green shows degradation within the monitoring window.
